definitions.explanation: Humble term used when referring to one's own father when speaking to others outside the family.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{会社員|かいしゃいん}です。
examples.english: My father is a company employee.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{今|いま}{出張中|しゅっちょうちゅう}です。
examples.english: My father is currently on a business trip.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}の{誕生日|たんじょうび}は5{月|がつ}です。
examples.english: My father's birthday is in May.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{料理|りょうり}が{上手|じょうず}で、{週末|しゅうまつ}はよく{作|つく}ります。
examples.english: My father is good at cooking and often cooks on weekends.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{時|とき}、{父|ちち}に{自転車|じてんしゃ}の{乗|の}り{方|かた}を{教|おし}えてもらいました。
examples.english: When I was a child, my father taught me how to ride a bicycle.

notes:
{父|ちち} is the humble term for "father," used when referring to one's own father when speaking to people outside the family.

POLITENESS SYSTEM:
- {父|ちち}: my father (humble, to outsiders)
- お{父|とう}さん: father (neutral, direct address or others' fathers)
- お{父|とう}さま: father (very polite/formal)
- パパ: dad (casual, childish)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {父|ちち}の{日|ひ}: Father's Day
- {父|ちち}{親|おや}: father (formal/written)
- {父|ちち}{方|かた}: paternal side (of family)

USAGE NOTE: In casual family settings, children may call their father お{父|とう}さん or パパ. {父|ちち} is specifically for humble reference when talking to outsiders.

RELATED: {母|はは} (mother - humble)
